title: parseDuration turns text like "1h30m" into seconds
goal: parseDuration turns text like "1h30m" into a number of seconds
body: Make parseDuration(text) in duration.js turn a duration such as "1h30m" into a number of seconds.

criteria.rule: Returns the total number of seconds as a number
criteria.name: parseDuration

criteria.rule: The units h, m and s can be combined in one string
criteria.name: parseDuration

criteria.rule: Returns null for text it cannot parse
criteria.name: parseDuration
